items.title: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
items.description: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 99% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 9.6.

w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for Progress LoadMaster per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-08-10)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; EPSS puts exploitation probability at 99% within 30 days; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached; edge/network devices are internet-facing and a top initial-access vector.

impact.affected_versions: Progress LoadMaster (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Identify all internet-facing Progress LoadMaster devices. Check firmware versions against the advisory, and review access logs for unauthorized access, unusual processes, or configuration changes.
